SELECT round((o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh))::numeric, 4)
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN operational_metrics o ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops
WHERE lower(p.sitelabel) = 'solar plant west davidport'

SELECT SUM(15 * 500000 * 0.12) AS grand_total
FROM plants p
JOIN panel_models pm ON p.modhook = pm.modkey
WHERE p.warrstate = 'claimed'
  AND p.warrclaims >= 3
  AND p.goliveon IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.degyrrate IS NOT NULL
